output.title: Route53 deletion fix: DNS01 solver usage not shown
output.content: The change fixes Route53 not-found error detection when DNS records are deleted, which only matters if an ACME DNS01 solver uses AWS Route53. The environment summary shows cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD, but no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests and no solver configuration. The crds dimension is absent and the values keys listed do not mention Route53 or DNS01. The operator should check whether any Issuer or ClusterIssuer uses acme.solvers.dns01.route53, which is not in the supplied inputs.
